hooks.command: git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null; BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{upstream} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$BEHIND" -gt 0 ]; then echo "WARNING: this working tree is $BEHIND commit(s) behind $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream}). The files you are about to read are NOT what is deployed. Run 'git pull --ff-only' before drawing any conclusion about the live site."; fi
